summary: Master Engineering Specification for premium, native-feeling mobile interface redesign for Git Manager. Covers charcoal color system (#0A0A0B to #242428), Geist/Geist Mono typography, 56px sticky header, horizontal repo pill tabs, 5-tab safe-area bottom navigation, Repositories screen with sliding sort sheet, Files tab with bottom code sheet, Commits timeline with unified diffs, and ActionSheet.
